C-101.why: Joel's rejection rests on his motor-vehicle record (R-101, delivered 7 October), he signed the authorization on 29 September, and no pre-adverse notice has gone. The policy gives 2 business days from the report's arrival, so it is due today, Friday 9 October. FCRA 604(b)(3)(A): the report copy and the summary of rights go together, before the rejection

C-102.why: Paulina's rejection rests on the employment check (R-102, delivered 8 October); her authorization is signed and nothing has been sent. Two business days from 8 October is Tuesday 13 October, because Monday 12 October is a company holiday; it may go today

C-103.why: Desmond's rejection rests in part on the report (the interview scored 2 of 5, and the employment check R-103 shows a dismissal he left off): a decision based in whole or in part on a report needs the notice (604(b)(3)(A)). The report arrived 5 October, so the notice was due 7 October and is overdue; nothing has been sent

C-214.why: Ingrid's notice of 24 September (N-1) carried the copy of the report and no summary of rights, so it did not meet 604(b)(3)(A) and the policy says to send it again complete, with the wait starting from the new date. Only the notice log shows what was attached

traps.C-204: Beatrix's complete pre-adverse notice went on 2 October (N-9); a second one is a duplicate, and her wait is still running
traps.C-207: Lucinda disputed her report and Veritarn reissued it clear on 5 October: the rejection has no report behind it, so no notice of either kind is owed
traps.C-209: Gideon was turned down for failing the skills test and the report was not a factor (scope): no pre-adverse notice is owed
traps.C-210: Hana's report is clear and she was hired: nothing adverse is being done
traps.C-211: Corwin signed no authorization (the form was never returned) and a recruiter ordered his report anyway: a report ordered without one is not used (604(b)(2)), so no rejection or notice rests on it
traps.C-212: Priya already had both notices (N-2 and N-3): the matter is finished
traps.C-213: Mateo withdrew on 30 September: no adverse action is being taken on the report

C-201.why: Wyatt's complete pre-adverse notice went on Monday 28 September (N-6). Five full business days are 29 September to 5 October, so the sixth business day, 6 October, has passed; no dispute, the report still shows the suspension. 615(a): the notice names Veritarn with address and phone, says it did not decide, and gives the 60-day free copy and the right to dispute

C-202.why: Noreen's complete pre-adverse notice went on Wednesday 30 September (N-7); five full business days run to 7 October, the sixth is 8 October, and her 6 October message says the report is accurate and she has no dispute

C-203.why: Kenji's complete pre-adverse notice went on Thursday 1 October (N-8). The five full business days are 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 October, so today, Friday 9 October, is the sixth business day and the earliest the final notice may go; no dispute

traps.C-101: Joel has had no pre-adverse notice yet: a final notice with none first skips 604(b)(3)(A) and the policy's order
traps.C-204: Beatrix's pre-adverse notice went on Friday 2 October. The five full business days are 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 October, so today is the last day of her wait; the final notice may go on Tuesday 13 October, the sixth business day, because Monday 12 October is a company holiday
traps.C-205: Orrin's pre-adverse notice went on Tuesday 6 October: his wait runs to 13 October (with Columbus Day out). The transport manager's request to skip the wait is not the policy
traps.C-207: Lucinda's dispute produced a corrected, clear report on 5 October: no adverse action rests on it any longer
traps.C-208: Tomas wrote on 2 October that the record belongs to a namesake with another birth year. A dispute is open in substance, so his final notice waits until Veritarn answers (policy: dispute)
traps.C-209: Gideon was turned down for the skills test, not the report: no notice of either kind
traps.C-211: Corwin signed no authorization and has had no pre-adverse notice: the report is not used
traps.C-212: Priya's final notice already went on 28 September (N-3): a second is a duplicate
traps.C-213: Mateo withdrew: nothing adverse is being done
traps.C-214: Ingrid's only notice went without the summary of rights: it is sent again complete first, and her wait starts from that date

R-208.why: Tomas Brandl wrote on 2 October that the theft record belongs to another man of his name born in 1988; only his message in Postwren shows it, and Veritarn's page logs no dispute. The policy sends the candidate's statement to the vendor the day HR reads it, and holds his final notice

traps.R-207: Lucinda's dispute was resolved: Veritarn reissued a clear report on 5 October, so there is nothing to forward
traps.R-202: Noreen wrote that her report is accurate and she has no dispute
